targetSenders().details: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

attackerReplaysPaymentId(uint256).notice: Adversary: replay the most recently used paymentId. The contract MUST reject it (usedPaymentIds idempotency). A success here means a double-settle bug.

attackerTriesDrainEarnings(uint256).notice: Adversary: actor `a` withdraws. withdraw() only ever pays msg.sender's own earnings — it can never reduce another actor's earnings. We snapshot all OTHER actors' earnings before the call and assert they are untouched after, proving pull-pattern isolation under random sequences.

attackerTriesPrivileged(uint256,uint256,.notice: Adversary: a random actor tries privileged ops; all must revert (access control).

changeFeeWithTimelock(uint256).notice: Fee timelock: propose then (after warp) execute. Random bps in valid range.

depositForKey(uint256,uint256).notice: Fund a key owned by a fuzzed actor with USDC (deposit increases obligations).

emergencyWithdrawUSDC(uint256).notice: Emergency USDC withdrawal (owner only, paused, excess only).

ghost_creatorEarningsCredited().notice: total creator share credited to earnings (cumulative, never decremented)

ghost_depositedIntoContract().notice: total USDC that has entered the contract via deposits + registration fees

ghost_feeFormulaMismatchCount().notice: running sum: every platformShare must equal floor(amount*feeBps/10000)

ghost_platformFeesToTreasury().notice: total platform fees forwarded to treasury (across all settle paths)

ghost_replaysRejected().notice: count of replay attempts that the contract correctly rejected

ghost_splitMismatchCount().notice: running sum: every settlement's platformShare+creatorShare must equal amount

ghost_withdrawnFromContract().notice: USDC pulled out by creators/owners/keys (withdraw paths + emergency USDC)

lastPaymentId().notice: last paymentId actually recorded — used by the replay-attack action

recordInvocation(uint256).notice: Record an x402 invocation (Flow x402). Requires free balance in the contract.

refundKeyToEarnings(uint256).notice: Operator moves a key's remaining balance into the owner's earnings.

registerAgent(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Register an agent owned by a fuzzed actor (idempotent on slug).

settleKeyBatch(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Settle a single registered call against a funded key (Flow Key).

strayDonation(uint256).notice: Inject "stray" USDC into the contract (accidental transfer) — must never make the contract insolvent and must be recoverable only as excess.

withdrawKey(uint256,uint256).notice: Key owner withdraws part of their own key balance.
